issues.title: Circular/Self-Referential Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: AC-01 through AC-05 in §97 define the 'structural floor' for the module itself, but the module's purpose is to consolidate 35 other files. There are no GWT criteria for the actual content/logic of the 35 guidelines.
issues.fix: Add a 'Content Integrity' AC requiring each rollup file to match its source module's normative tables/regex/schemas byte-for-byte.

issues.title: Missing Worked Examples for Consolidated Format
issues.why: While the module contains many files, the provided context (Overview/AC/Changelog) lacks a sample of how a source spec is actually 'condensed' into a rollup file.
issues.fix: Add a 'Worked Example' section to §97 showing a 3-paragraph source spec mapped to a 1-paragraph consolidated summary.

issues.title: Aspirational Folder References
issues.why: The File Inventory (e.g., 08-docs-viewer-ui.md) references source modules like '08-docs-viewer-ui/' which are noted as aspirational/not yet existing, potentially confusing a blind AI.
issues.fix: Mark aspirational rows in the §00 inventory table with a [STUB] prefix and a note that the source folder is not yet materialised.
